extracted.intended_audience: students, researchers, policymakers, and general readers seeking country reference data
extracted.subtask_description: Compiling or using structured country profiles (Factbook-style) that list geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues. Includes both short data fields (GDP, population) and narrative background/overview entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative historical/political background summarizing major historical events and recent political developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides concise historical context and recent political changes (e.g., coups, revolutions, regime changes). Examples in the text include details about dictatorships, wars, and the 'Orange Revolution'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic placement of the country (region, relative location).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short descriptor such as 'Eastern Africa, west of Kenya' or 'Eastern Europe, bordering the Black Sea'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude of the country (degrees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Map regions or continents used for map indexing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Africa', 'Asia, Europe'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area (total/water/land)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total area with breakdown into water and land in sq km.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes fields like 'total', 'water', 'land' with numeric values and year of estimate when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: A familiar-area comparison (e.g., 'slightly smaller than Oregon').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps readers contextualize country size using well-known regions or states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of land boundaries and bordering countries with lengths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists total km and per-border breakdown (e.g., 'Democratic Republic of the Congo 765 km').

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of the coastline in km (or '0 km' if landlocked).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Territorial sea, exclusive economic zone, continental shelf claims and other maritime jurisdiction notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example entries: 'territorial sea: 12 nm; exclusive economic zone: 200 nm; continental shelf: 200-m or to the depth of exploitation.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Brief summary of the country's climate (zones, rainy/dry seasons).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May note regional variations and timing of seasons (e.g., 'tropical; generally rainy with two dry seasons').

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Characterization of dominant terrain types (plains, plateaus, mountains, atolls).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise phrases like 'mostly plateau with rim of mountains' or 'fertile plains (steppes)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest points with elevations and place names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'lowest point: Lake Albert 621 m; highest point: Margherita Peak on Mount Stanley 5,110 m.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of known natural resources (minerals, arable land, hydropower, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short enumerations such as 'copper, cobalt, hydropower, limestone, salt, arable land'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent breakdown of land use (arable land, permanent crops, other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as percentages and year when available (e.g., 'arable land: 25.88%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land in sq km with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Noted natural hazards affecting the country (or 'NA' if none listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Current environmental problems (deforestation, pollution, wetland draining, poaching, radiation contamination, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative descriptions citing specific issues, e.g., 'draining of wetlands for agricultural use; deforestation; overgrazing; soil erosion; water hyacinth infestation in Lake Victoria; poaching is widespread.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international environmental agreements to which the country is a party or has signed but not ratified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as 'party to:' and 'signed, but not ratified:' lists (e.g., 'Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol').

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional geographic note or summary about strategic position or notable geographical features.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short explanatory sentence like 'landlocked; fertile, well-watered country with many lakes and rivers' or 'strategic position at the crossroads between Europe and Asia.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Population
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population with year and important estimation notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include caveats (e.g., 'estimates for this country explicitly take into account the effects of excess mortality due to AIDS').

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Population breakdown by age cohorts (0-14, 15-64, 65+), often with male/female numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Given as percentages and sometimes absolute counts (e.g., '0-14 years: 50.6% (male 6,696,193; female 6,653,764)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age of total population and sometimes male/female medians.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate (percentage) with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude birth rate per 1,000 population with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude death rate per 1,000 population with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migrants per 1,000 population with notes where relevant (e.g., refugee populations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include narrative about refugee hosting and cross-border flows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Sex ratio at birth, by age groups, and total population (males per female).

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, sometimes given for male/female breakdown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy in years for total population and by sex with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average children born per woman with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - adult prevalence rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage adult prevalence of HIV/AIDS with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - people living with HIV/AIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of people living with HIV/AIDS with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - deaths
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated deaths from HIV/AIDS with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major infectious diseases
rubrics_metrics.description: List of major infectious diseases and overall degree of risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'typhoid fever, malaria, trypanosomiasis, schistosomiasis; overall degree of risk: very high.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality
rubrics_metrics.description: Noun and adjective forms for the country's nationals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple entry like 'noun: Ugandan(s); adjective: Ugandan.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of ethnic composition by percentage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists major groups and percentages (e.g., 'Baganda 17%, Ankole 8%, ... other 8%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions
rubrics_metrics.description: Religious composition by percentage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'Roman Catholic 33%, Protestant 33%, Muslim 16%, indigenous beliefs 18%.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and commonly used languages with usage notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May note official status and contexts of use (e.g., English taught in schools, used in courts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition used and literacy rates for total, male, and female populations with year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition often provided: 'age 15 and over can read and write.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional long and short forms of the country's name and former/local variants where given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include local long form, former names, and local short form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Form of government (e.g., 'republic').

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Capital city name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal subdivisions with counts and examples (provinces, districts, oblasts, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes names of subdivisions where provided and notes on status (e.g., municipalities with oblast status).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of independence and from whom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., '9 October 1962 (from UK)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal national holiday and date (often independence day).

rubrics_metrics.name: Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of adoption or promulgation of the constitution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Basis of the legal system and notes about jurisdiction (e.g., 'based on civil law; judicial review of legislative acts').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May note acceptance of ICJ jurisdiction and other reservations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age and whether suffrage is universal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of state, head of government, cabinet appointment process, and election notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes narrative notes about dual roles (e.g., president both chief of state and head of government), appointment/confirmation procedures, and recent election results or anomalies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Legislature type (unicameral/bicameral), number of seats, composition, election rules, and term lengths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include specifics such as '303 members - 214 directly elected, 81 nominated by special interest groups' or electoral thresholds for party lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Top courts and appointment notes (e.g., Supreme Court, Constitutional Court, Court of Appeal, High Court).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May describe appointment methods and appeal routes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing of major political parties, leaders, and notes about party system (e.g., single organization allowed, suspended parties).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include explanatory notes about the political environment (e.g., Movement vs. political parties).

rubrics_metrics.name: Political pressure groups and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Noted pressure groups or movements and leaders where present.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in, often abbreviated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long lists such as 'ACP, AfDB, AU, ... WTO' may be provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation in the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Details of the country's diplomatic mission to the US including address, phone, fax and chief of mission if provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: mission chancery address in Washington DC and contact numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation from the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Details of the US diplomatic mission to the country including ambassador, embassy address, mailing address, phone and fax.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Verbal description of the national flag and symbolism where provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'light blue with the flag of the UK in the upper hoist-side quadrant; nine yellow five-pointed stars symbolizing the nine islands.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative overview of the country's economy, main sectors, sources of revenue, and major economic policies or challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May mention dependence on foreign aid, trust funds, privatization, structural reforms, or sectoral dominance (e.g., agriculture).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (purchasing power parity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross domestic product measured at PPP with currency units and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual real growth rate percentage of GDP with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita at purchasing power parity with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent contribution of agriculture, industry, and services to GDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross fixed investment as percent of GDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of population below national poverty line with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption - percentage share
rubrics_metrics.description: Income or consumption distribution by percentage share for lowest and highest deciles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields like 'lowest 10%: 4%; highest 10%: 21% (2000)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of family income - Gini index
rubrics_metrics.description: Gini coefficient for income distribution with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual inflation rate percentage with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force
rubrics_metrics.description: Size of the labor force (absolute number) with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force - by occupation
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent distribution of labor force across agriculture, industry, services, or narrative on livelihood sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include narrative like 'people make a living mainly through exploitation of the sea, reefs, and atolls and from wages sent home by those abroad.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Unemployment rate percentage with year of estimate or 'NA' if not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget (revenues and expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Government revenues and expenditures in currency units with year of estimate and capital expenditures noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Public debt as percent of GDP or absolute figure with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: Main agricultural products (short list).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'coconuts; fish' or 'coffee, tea, cotton, tobacco, cassava'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal industries and industrial activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'fishing, tourism, copra' or 'sugar, brewing, tobacco, cotton textiles, cement.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual industrial production growth rate percentage with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - production/consumption/exports/imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production and consumption (kWh) and exports/imports with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - production/consumption/exports/imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil production/consumption/exports/import data in barrels per day or NA where not applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current account balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Current account balance in currency units with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total exports value (f.o.b.) with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal export commodities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Major export destination countries with percentage shares and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports (value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total imports value (c.i.f. or f.o.b.) with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal import commodities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Major import source countries with percentage shares and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign exchange & gold reserves value with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: External debt absolute figure with year of estimate or 'NA'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of economic aid received and major donors noted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include narrative 'major donors are Australia, Japan, and the US.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency
rubrics_metrics.description: Name(s) of currency used in country with any notes (e.g., use of Australian dollar alongside local unit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency code
rubrics_metrics.description: Three-letter currency code (ISO) such as 'AUD' or 'UGX'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Exchange rate(s) of local currency per US dollar with historical values and years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists multiple years for context (e.g., 2003, 2002, 2001, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Country's fiscal year period (calendar year or specific dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - Telephones (main lines in use)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of main telephone lines in use with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - Telephones (mobile cellular)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of mobile cellular subscribers with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephone system
rubrics_metrics.description: General assessment and details of domestic and international telephone/communications systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes 'general assessment' narrative and separate 'domestic' and 'international' notes (e.g., 'serves particular needs for internal communications').

rubrics_metrics.name: Radio broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of AM/FM/shortwave radio broadcast stations with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radios
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of radios (receivers) with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Television broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of television broadcast stations with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Televisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of television sets with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet country code
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet country code top-level domain (ccTLD), e.g., '.tv', '.ug', '.ua'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of internet hosts registered with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet Service Providers (ISPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of ISPs operating in the country with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet users
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of internet users with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - Railways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of railways and gauge information where provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - Highways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of highways with breakdown paved vs unpaved and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - Waterways
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of navigable waterways with context (e.g., lakes, rivers) and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ports and harbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal ports and harbors used for maritime traffic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merchant marine
rubrics_metrics.description: Merchant marine fleet totals, types, GRT/DWT, and foreign ownership notes with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of airports with totals and runway surface types (paved/unpaved) and runway-length breakdowns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Existence and names of military branches (army, navy, air force) or absence of regular military forces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May note policing roles (e.g., Police Force includes Maritime Surveillance Unit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - age and obligation
rubrics_metrics.description: Military age for compulsory/voluntary duty and statements about recruitment ages and consent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: '18 years of age for compulsory and voluntary military duty; government has stated recruitment below that age could occur with proper consent...'

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - availability/fit for service
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimates of the number of males available and fit for military service in specified age ranges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - dollar figure
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending in currency units with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - percent of GDP
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending as a percent of GDP with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - Disputes (international)
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes involving the country or 'none' if none listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative descriptions may include regional conflicts or cross-border ethnic/rebel activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refugees and internally displaced persons
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbers of refugees hosted (by country of origin) and internally displaced persons with context (e.g., causes such as rebellion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes narrative context such as 'IDPs: 1.4 million (ongoing LRA rebellion, mainly in the north; LRA frequently attacks IDP camps) (2004)'.
